Viral Story: Haryanvi Singer Kajal Chaudhary Carries 90-Year-Old Mother-in-Law in Kanwar from Haridwar to Delhi

At a time when relationships are often questioned, Kajal Chaudhary has redefined the bond between a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law. 
She is currently performing a Kanwar Yatra from Haridwar to Delhi with her elderly, immobile mother-in-law seated in a kanwar. 
This comes after her earlier act of completing the 84 Kos Braj Parikrama with her saas on her head.

A true example of love, culture, and devotion.
